name: vue-text-ellipsis-center-root
description: Root package for vue-text-ellipsis-center monorepo - A Vue 3 component for intelligent text ellipsis with center truncation support

scripts.dev: vite build && pnpm --filter vue-text-ellipsis-center-examples run dev
scripts.test:contracts: vitest run test/release-contract.test.ts test/render-implementation-contract.test.ts test/vue-compat-contract.test.ts test/core-runtime-deps.test.ts test/docs-examples-contract.test.ts test/vue-bridge.test.ts
scripts.verify:release: pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e && node scripts/check-release-contract.mjs && cd src && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test && npm run build
